text: Very friendly and knowledgeable of whale locations.  We were originally booked on a smaller boat but when weather wasn't safe for small crafts, they gave us the option to go on the 45 passenger boat, refund was quick and they had us booked on the larger boat so everything was seamless and no hassle.  The larger boat was just as nice and we seen whales up close and personal.  Would book again.
Great Trip - Hannah and Alec did a great job of spotting whales for us.  We were blessed to see a whale breech.  The trip to the lighthouse was a nice bonus.
Best whale watching experience in my life! I would highly recommend!
Excellent day whale watching! Captain Dalton, Nick, and Grace were very accommodating and helpful in spotting activity and getting us where we got the best views.
Chris and captain Dan did a great job of finding multiple humpbacks, including a bubble feeding pod - thank you for an amazing experience ❣️
Never thought that being in jail, whale jail that is, would be so much fun. Coral our naturalist and Captain Dan made our whale watching trip one to remember!

This was by far our best excursion ever! Dalton, Tess, and Ayden truly made the trip something special. Their deep appreciation and passion for the world around us and desire to share it were beautiful to see. We saw so much wildlife and learned so much from them! We saw a big black bear trotting down the street in Juneau on our bus ride to the boat, several whales including a mom and calf, eagles, sea lions, and salmon. It was so cool! They offered snacks, water, coffee, soda, and even had a bit of raindeer sausage and locally made fudge as a treat. To top it off, they shared photos with us that they had taken with their badass cameras, which came out SO much better than my tiny phone. The boat was beautiful, spacious and clean. And one big thing is the seats were comfortable! That was a huge plus. Just all around a wonderful experience that we would highly recommend. Thanks again you guys for the awesome experience!!

Harv and Marv was a fantastic experience for the whole family, ages 6 - 76. Picked up on the dock by the funny and professional Chris who was very polite and accommodating. We did the double decker Catamaran tour and the boat was very clean an comfortable. Capt. Steve, Grace and Hannah were friendly, knowledgeable and very pleasant to chat with.
We saw whales, orca, eagles and stunning views.
It was also several hundred less than booking through the cruise ship.
If you are going to do a tour in Juneau, do it with Harv and Marv.

Graham was a fun, thoughtful, safe and scientific guide to the whales and orcas we saw. It wad a life-changing experience! The foggy day was actually perfect for noticing the black shapes in the water. The small vessel was the perfect fit for us 2 and 4 other passengers. The snacks, restroom and local whale name fluke ID binder were a plus! The admin team was supportive as wwll. They were very understanding and made things right when there was a hiccup in the non-cruise passenger dock meetup instructions.
Captain Dan and Dale were excellent hosts for the whale watching excursion! Was a beautiful day and we saw many whales!

We just completed a private whale watching tour. Truly an amazing experience.

Bus transport to and from the cruise port was timely and comfortable. Transfer from the bus to the boat was very efficient.

The boat was smaller as it was a private tour, but remarkably stable on the water, even with wake from larger vessels. Everything was obviously well kept and maintained. There was ample space for our entire group of 4. Snacks and drinks were provided which is a nice touch, especially with kids along.

Our Captain Jase, was friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. He did an outstanding job and highly recommended him personally as well as the company in general.

The whales and other wildlife were in abundance and we were able to get to the legal minimum distance to watch them bubble feeding. On our way back one surfaced even closer to us and swam along near us for a time. Definitely a once in a lifetime experience that is worth doing twice.
We had a fantastic time seeing Humpback Whales playing and feeding out of Juno. Our captain, Dillion, took us right to where the whales were. Great sightings!

Had an amazing day on the water with Captain Rich from Harv and Marv’s tours. Lucky enough to see two pods of humpbacks bubble net feeding and Rich was fantastic at getting us into position for great viewing. An absolute highlight of our trip.

The whale watching tour was absolutely incredible. Our naturalists, Hannah and Anika, were phenomenal. (Anika's mom--if you are reading this, you should be proud. She's a remarkable guide! Same goes for Hannah!) They obviously love the whales and delight in sharing their knowledge! They know the whales by name and can identify them as they dive and show their flukes. We talked to several people who booked with different companies, but none of their naturalists put a microphone into the water to hear the whales preparing to bubble net feed. We all listened as the "caller" whale's sound increased in intensity, then Anika would point exactly where and when the bubble net group would surface. A truly stunning, even sacred, experience.
Incredible whale watching cruise with Dalton, Coral and Meredith (Harvey & Marv)! Saw an incredible amount of whales bubble-net feeding!  Best tour we took on this trip!

Capt. Dan and Coral put us on whales right away.  They had a very clean and dry vessel.   They were polite, knowledgeable,  and courteous naturalists.  We got to see 3 different  bubble feeding episodes.  I would recommend using them on your whale watching adventure.  Donnie provided a fun and entertaining ride to and from our ship.
Great guides and awesome whale watching!
This was an amazing trip.  Thanks to the great crew!
The whale watching tour was amazing.  The crew was very knowledgeable & we saw a lot of whales.

My family did the Original Whale Watch tour on 8/1 on a 6 passenger boat. The entire experience was exceptional! From pick-up at our cruise dock, Donny, our driver was great, personable and so proud to be from Juneau; he also gave great recommendations of places to visit in town.

We were so lucky to have Captain Graham; he was fabulous at answering all of our questions, explaining things to us and making the entire experience the highlight of our cruise. We will certainly tell all our friends and family to book this excursion. 10/10

PS- I'd love to see some Harv and Marv's merch!
Awesome adventure!!  Chris was fantastic and extremely knowledgeable.
The trip was amazing. It exceeded our expectations. The crew was knowledgeable and friendly and I would recommend this excursion to everyone!!
This tour was a highlight of our Alaskan adventure!  Saw several whales up close…loved the lighthouse tour…crew was friendly and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

We were on the Chilkat with Captain Dan and Chris for a whale watch in June.  It was a wonderful trip. Saw all kinds of wildlife, and most of all, lots of whales.  The knowledge of the captain and crew member was exceptional. Had a fantastic time.

The catamarans we use for offshore work always provide a more comfortable ride and this boat was a real gem.  The bathrooms were very clean and Cpt Mac is adamant about a clean vessel, especially the windows.
Thank You for a fantastic tour.

Marv’s signature whale watching tour. Absolutely top tour. We got to see humpbacks bubble feeding; orcas; sea lions; seals; a sea otter; and bald eagles. But regardless, the trip itself, guide, skipper, bus driver were all excellent.
Excellent tour with lots of whales and first-hand knowledge of the individual whales themselves.

Do yourself a favor and book your whale watching with these guys. The Polaris is the best boat I’ve been on for one of these tours. Captain Dalton, Daniel, and Grace are the best crew ever. Saw lots of whales and learned a lot. Daniel took lots of professional photos and shared them all with us as part of the package. Can’t say enough about this professional crew!
We had a beautiful evening of whale watching.    Our guide Daniel was amazing.    The whales were awesome.   I would recommend this company to anyone visiting Juneau.

Great tour! The crew was friendly and knowledgeable and even accommodated our late arrival due to our cruise getting delayed to port. Thank you Hannah, Grace Ann and Capt Stephen for a trip I will never forget!

We had a fantastic time on the Pharos and were very pleased with the crew. I believe we saw 6 or 8 different whales and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The Pharos was a really nice boat and it was especially nice to be inside the cabin when we were scooting across the water! I highly recommend Harv and Marv’s.
Exceptional! Book now

Unbelievable experience! Our 2nd tour with Harv and Marv. We loved our first trip a couple of years ago so we came back with our group of 8 on a 12 person boat! Harv and Marvs is the way to go! I shopped around and we booked the Chillkat, which was the 18person boat and it was perfect.

Coral, our naturalist, was engaging and knowledgeable, sharing a wealth of information about whales and helping us identify who and what we were seeing. place_name: Harv and Marv's Outback Alaska Whale Watching
text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience with Harv and Marv’s Outback Alaska Whale Watching! Graham was our captain, and he made the entire trip unforgettable. He was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about the area and the wildlife.

We were lucky enough to see so many whales throughout the tour, and Graham did a fantastic job getting us into great viewing spots while still being respectful of the animals. He shared tons of interesting information along the way and made the whole experience fun and relaxed.

The boat was beautiful, comfortable, and perfect for a private tour. Having the boat to ourselves made the experience feel even more special and personal. The scenery around Juneau was incredible, and seeing whales up close in such a beautiful setting was easily one of the highlights of our Alaska trip.

If you’re looking for a more personal whale-watching experience instead of being packed onto a huge tour boat, I can’t recommend Harv and Marv’s enough. And if you get Graham as your captain, you’re in great hands. We would absolutely do this again!

place_name: Harv and Marv's Outback Alaska Whale Watching
text: This is my second time to Alaska and this whale watching tour was the highlight of my vacation. Captain Mac knew right where to go to find the whales, and Kaylin and Corral were wonderful at telling us all about their resident whales. Our first whale we got to see surface feeding before taking a deep dive and seeing that magnificent tail! And we even got to see a brand new whale with white pectoral fins and white tail who is said to be brand new to the area. We got to see the Mother “Barnacles” and her 8 month old calf. The calf was playing with a pod of Dolphins who then decided to join our Boat “Pharos” and swam along side the boat, playing in our wake. So much fun! We then headed off to the Juneau Lighthouse and saw the Steller seals sleeping on the bell, Bald Eagles, Mendenhall Glacier and Herbert Glacier. The Lighthouse was really something to see and the island is so peaceful. The weather was perfect. We managed to see everything just before the September storm rolled in.  Definitely worthwhile!

place_name: Harv and Marv's Outback Alaska Whale Watching
text: This was one of the most special experiences of my life. We saw a mother whale named Barnacles bonding with her calf Goose. They were leaping out of the water! place_name: Harv and Marv's Outback Alaska Whale Watching
text: What an awesome experience! My wife and I booked this tour through Costco Shore Excursions and couldn’t have been happier with how it turned out. We were on Anthem of the Seas (Royal Caribbean) and they picked us up right at the end of the pier in Juneau. Our bus driver, Chris, was very knowledgeable about the area and provided a good tour on the way to the marina. We sailed on Beacon with Captain Stephen, Hannah, and Chris (different from the bus driver). Saw several whales and sea otters in one of the most picturesque places on the planet, and a whale even swam underneath our boat and got super close! They provided snacks and drinks and got us back to the pier/downtown with plenty of time to grab lunch and explore town. Would give more than 5 stars if I could! Don’t hesitate to book with them, you won’t be sorry! (Edited to add photo & video)

place_name: Harv and Marv's Outback Alaska Whale Watching
text: We had a fantastic experience this past July with Captain Dan and Alexis! We were lucky enough to spot 13–14 whales, plus sea otters and sea lions! It’s clear the crew is extremely knowledgeable and genuinely passionate about local ecology. Highly recommend Harv & Marv's!
